Best bound: the larger of our construction (planner of the Atelier Ramsey) and the best published value (Radziszowski, Small Ramsey Numbers, rev. 18, Table XIb and the Atelier's records table, used for the same parameters or by monotonicity).

“Published” and “Published (deduced)”: the best result is the published value (same parameters, or deduced from published values by monotonicity). The theorem-based deductions used in the Atlas sheet (quadrupling, Robertson, products) were NOT recomputed here.

“Published bricks + theorems”: built with published bricks and theorems; none of our bricks is involved. “Our bricks + published”: one of our bricks adds a margin. “Our bricks”: without our bricks the construction would fall below the best published value.

“Bound without our bricks”: the planner's result when all our bricks are removed. When no published value is known for the same parameters or by monotonicity, the column “Best published value used” is empty and no comparison with the literature is made.
